name: MAXLAND
recent: MAXLAND 于2026年10月完成可放弃附加股发行，发售价每股 RM0.025，比例 1:1，最终认购不足 52.89%，但达到最低认购水平，附加股预计 2026年11月23日上市。公司于2026年10月30日发布截至2026年8月31日季度业绩。近期董事及委员会成员有变动。
notable: 完成可放弃附加股发行，发售价 RM0.025，比例 1:1，认购率 47.11%，认购不足 52.89%，但达到最低认购水平。
附加股预计于 2026年11月23日在大马交易所主板上市。
2026年9月8日举行股东大会，结果公布。
risks: 附加股发行认购不足 52.89%，虽达到最低认购水平，但反映认购率偏低。
董事在闭门期前表示有意交易公司证券。
董事及委员会成员近期出现变动。

events.what_en: Despatch of prospectus and allotment letter

recent_en: MAXLAND completed a renounceable rights issue in October 2026 at RM0.025 per share on a 1-for-1 basis, with a 52.89% under-subscription but meeting the minimum subscription level; the rights shares are expected to be listed on 23 November 2026. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 31 August 2026 on 30 October 2026. There were recent changes in directors and board committees.
notable_en: Completed renounceable rights issue at RM0.025 per share on a 1-for-1 basis, with 47.11% acceptance and 52.89% under-subscription, but meeting the minimum subscription level.
Rights shares are expected to be listed on the Main Market of Bursa Securities on 23 November 2026.
General meetings were held on 8 September 2026 and the outcomes were announced.
risks_en: The rights issue was under-subscribed by 52.89%; although the minimum subscription level was met, the take-up rate was low.
Directors indicated intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
There were recent changes in directors and board committee members.
